description: This file defines the ResultPaginator class within the Aws namespace. The class implements an iterator for paginating through results of AWS SDK operations, supporting asynchronous iteration, applying search expressions, and managing pagination tokens.

classes.name: ResultPaginator
classes.description: An iterator class for handling paginated AWS SDK results, supporting synchronous and asynchronous iteration with token management and search functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the paginator with client, operation name, arguments, and configuration, and sets up metrics collection middleware.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Runs the paginator asynchronously, processing each page with a callback that can return promises, supporting complex asynchronous flows.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Applies a JMESPath expression to each result yielded by the iterator, returning a flattened array of search results.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current result object or false if invalid.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current request count as the key or null if not valid.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Resets the current result, advancing the iterator.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid, managing continuation based on tokens and request counts.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial state, preparing for a new iteration.

methods.name: createNextCommand
methods.description: Constructs the next command for the AWS client using current arguments and pagination tokens.

methods.name: determineNextToken
methods.description: Decides the next pagination token based on the current result and configuration.
